description: Create a sandbox. Creates a sandbox: a throwaway VM with no project, on the plain base image or on one of your projects' images. It answers at once while the sandbox starts; a command sent to it waits until it is up. It never sleeps and is deleted when `ttlMinutes` runs out (default 60, at most 1440).

env.description: Env vars every command run through this API gets. Stored encrypted.

orgId.description: The team it belongs to. Defaults to your first team (an API key's own team).

projectId.description: Start from this project's current image instead of the plain base image.

ttlMinutes.description: Minutes until the sandbox is deleted. Default 60, at most 1440.

name: sandbox_create
title: Create a sandbox
